newsitem.title: USA: Noel Group holders ok liquidation plan.
newsitem.headline: Noel Group holders ok liquidation plan.

text.p: Noel Group Inc said Thursday that its shareholders had approved a plan of complete liquidation and dissolution adopted previously by Noel's board.

Noel said it plans to file to register its 4,275,846 shares (29 percent) of HealthPlan Services Corp common stock before the end of March and distribute HealthPlan's stock to Noel shareholders afterward.
The company said it is considering various alternatives regarding its other assets and seeks to realize the highest possible value for shareholders.

Noel has been a public company since 1992 and has six primary holdings: stakes in HealthPlan Services; Staffing Resources Inc; Belding Heminway Co Inc, a button packager and distributor; Curtis Industries Inc; Lincoln Snacks Co and a 32 percent equity interest in a Brazilian corporation holding the concession for the privatized operation of the western network of the Brazilian federal rail system.
